The route

Not a detour from Tokyo. The way to Osaka.

Most first trips to Japan go Tokyo, then Kyoto and Osaka. The Snow Country Route keeps that trip and changes how you travel it: north by bullet train into the snow, two nights in Niigata, then a short ANA flight onward.

TokyoDay 1 · morning
Bullet trainfrom 1 h 37 min
NiigataTwo nights
ANA flightabout 1 h 10 min
OsakaDay 3 · afternoon

Through the tunnel

Board in Tokyo sunshine. One long mountain tunnel later, the world outside turns white: the border where Kawabata's Snow Country begins.

129 sakes at the station

Ponshukan, inside Echigo-Yuzawa station: five tasting coins for ¥1,000 and a sake concierge. Hop off on the way in.

Fly onward with ANA

Niigata to Osaka Itami in about 70 minutes. Kyoto or Osaka by the afternoon, with nothing done twice.

The honest trade: about two extra hours of travel, split over two days. And no Mount Fuji from this line; that view belongs to the direct Tokyo to Osaka train.
